title: Expand Default Compose Diagram Story
description: Create a compose UI Diagram component that renders a minimal absolute-placement preview of a design for mini-map usage. Use flattenDesign for absolute placements, draw clean center-to-center connection lines with filled circles for pieces on top, fit the drawing to the container size, and add a Storybook story for the Nakagin Capsule Tower using existing Metabolism assets. Extend existing checks in-place if needed and verify the compose/ui test and build flows relevant to this change.
summary: Updated the default compose/ui Diagram Nakagin story so it now includes selection plus diff coverage for added, removed, and modified pieces and connections in one default example. Re-verified compose/ui type-check and Storybook build.
